name: @w6w-apps/paddle
description: Manage the Paddle Billing catalog, customers, subscriptions, transactions and refunds — products, prices, subscription pause/resume/cancel, invoice PDFs and adjustments.

w6w.longDescription:
Paddle acts as merchant of record for a subscription business — selling the software, handling payment and sales tax, and issuing the invoice — which makes its API the system of record for what a customer is actually paying. This app reads and manages that lifecycle: products, prices and customers; subscriptions, including pausing, resuming and cancelling them; transactions and their invoice PDFs; and refunds and other adjustments.

Cancelling or pausing a subscription schedules the change for the end of the current billing period by default rather than applying immediately, and the subscription's status stays active until then — a detail this app surfaces explicitly so a workflow doesn't mistake a scheduled cancellation for a completed one. Adjustments cover both refunds against a completed transaction and credits against one that's still outstanding.

This app is built around Paddle Billing, the current generation of Paddle's API; it does not create new transactions or checkouts, change a subscription's price or proration, or manage discounts, notifications, or reporting exports, all of which stay out of scope for this first pass.
